<tabber>Permanent Achievements=
{{Achievement|Nothing Personal|png|Kill {{color|value|30}} [[Sniper (Payday 2)|snipers]] with any sniper rifle on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#John Wick Weapon Pack|Mustang]]" mask, "[[Materials#John Wick Weapon Pack|Tire]]" material and "[[Patterns#John Wick Weapon Pack|One Shot]]" pattern.}}
{{Achievement|Crouched and Hidden, Flying Dagger|png|Kill {{color|value|8}} guards with a throwing weapon while crouching on the [[Murky Station]] job. The heist must be finished for any kills to count. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#John Wick Weapon Pack|Hotelier]]" mask, "[[Materials#John Wick Weapon Pack|Club Lights]]" material and "[[Patterns#John Wick Weapon Pack|Piety]]" pattern.}}
{{Achievement|UMP for Me, UMP for You|png|Kill {{color|value|45}} Russian specials on the [[Boiling Point]] job with any submachine gun on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#John Wick Weapon Pack|Zaschita]]" mask, "[[Materials#John Wick Weapon Pack|Mist]]" material and "[[Patterns#John Wick Weapon Pack|Battle Wounds]]" pattern.}}
{{Achievement|For Daisy|png|Finish the [[Firestarter]] job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above with your crew using only pistols. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#John Wick Weapon Pack|Daisy]]" mask, "[[Materials#John Wick Weapon Pack|Dog Fur]]" material and "[[Patterns#John Wick Weapon Pack|Daisies]]" pattern.}}
